The sequence is deliberate: identify who is calling and what business they are in; state what the product is and is not in one plain sentence; ask about the household's situation and listen before describing anything; speak with the wearer directly and hear their view; describe the limits before the benefits, including that the device depends on power, on a working signal path and on being worn; give the all-in cost and the cancellation terms before asking for any decision; state honestly what the alternatives are, including doing nothing; and then, only then, ask whether the family wants to proceed, with no urgency attached. Two structural rules protect the whole sequence — the household keeps a written summary whether or not they buy, and no signature is taken on a first unsolicited visit to a person who is alone. The order is the control: a conversation that discloses in this sequence cannot easily become a pressure close, because the ask arrives after everything that would have been hidden.

included: the fixed disclosure-before-ask sequence and the reason each step precedes the next
the limits-before-benefits statement including power, signal-path and wearing dependencies
the written summary left regardless of outcome and the no-first-visit-signature rule
excluded: the technical home assessment and configuration walkthrough, which happen at installation
post-sale onboarding calls and check-ins, which belong to the retention knowledge base
closing techniques, urgency devices and objection-handling scripts designed to overcome reluctance

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a complaint about pressure or undisclosed terms, or an audit of recent consultations showing the sequence being reordered in practice

pros.claim: Fixing the order makes disclosure independent of willpower, which is what fails when a salesperson is behind for the month
pros.example: the cost page and cancellation terms being handed over before the question of proceeding is ever raised, on every call without exception

pros.claim: Limits-before-benefits pre-empts the disappointment that produces early cancellations and complaints to referrers
pros.example: stating plainly that the pendant does nothing in the shower if it has been left on the bedside table, before describing what it does when worn

cons.claim: A long structured conversation loses buyers who wanted a five-minute transaction, especially adult children calling from an airport
cons.example: a caregiver with fifteen minutes between flights abandoning the call partway through the limits section

cons.claim: A script followed mechanically can become its own kind of dishonesty, delivering disclosures nobody actually absorbed
cons.example: reciting the limitations at speed to a hard-of-hearing wearer and moving on

failure_modes: asking for the decision before the cost and cancellation terms have been stated
describing benefits first and limits only if the family thinks to ask
taking a signature on an unsolicited first visit from a person who is alone
acceptance_tests: the conversation record shows cost and cancellation terms disclosed before any request to proceed
the household holds a written summary regardless of whether they bought, and the wearer was spoken with directly or a documented reason exists
revisit_triggers: a complaint alleges pressure or surprise about terms
a new salesperson begins conducting consultations
the offer, price sheet or cancellation terms change

nodes.definition: Give the household one packet, in large readable type, containing everything they agreed to and everything they will need when something goes wrong. Its contents are fixed: the itemised cost page with the first-year total and the ongoing monthly figure; the cancellation and refund terms including the bereavement and higher-care clauses; a plain-language limitations statement saying that the equipment signals for help and does not prevent falls or provide medical care, that it depends on mains power, on a working signal path and on being worn, and that fall detection is a probabilistic feature which can both miss events and alarm falsely; the monitoring centre's role and what it is contracted to do; who to call for service, for billing and for cancellation, with the numbers on the front; the consent record for who may be contacted and told what; and the installation appointment with what will happen and be tested at it. The packet is left with the household rather than posted later, because the moment of maximum comprehension is while the person who explained it is still in the room, and because an absent sibling will read it before the first invoice arrives.

included: the fixed contents of the customer packet including cost, cancellation, limitations and contact information
the plain-language limitations statement covering power, signal path, wearing and fall-detection probabilism
the consent record for contact and information sharing, and the readable-type requirement
excluded: the emergency-contact tree configuration and the installation checklist itself, which belong to the device setup knowledge base
drafting enforceable contract language, which is counsel's work
service records and account correspondence generated after installation, which belong to the retention knowledge base

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: terms, pricing or product limitations change, or a customer reports never having received something the packet must contain

pros.claim: A single packet left in the home ends the argument about what was said, and it is the artifact an absent sibling reviews
pros.example: a son in another country reading the limitations page and the cost page rather than reconstructing a telephone conversation second-hand

pros.claim: Putting the limitations in writing before installation removes the false expectation that produces the angriest post-incident conversations
pros.example: a family who already knew, in writing, that a pendant left on the dresser cannot signal anything

cons.claim: A thorough packet is intimidating, and an overloaded one is read by nobody, which defeats its purpose
cons.example: a folder of technical documentation that goes into a drawer unopened while the cancellation number is needed a year later

cons.claim: Producing, updating and version-controlling the packet is standing administrative work that lapses quietly when terms change
cons.example: an old cancellation page still being handed out after the terms were improved

failure_modes: promising to post the paperwork later and never doing it
printing the limitations statement in small type at the back where nobody reads it
omitting the consent record so nobody knows who the family agreed could be told what
acceptance_tests: the packet contains every required section, in large readable type, with the service, billing and cancellation numbers on its front page
the limitations statement names power dependence, signal-path dependence, the need to wear the device, and fall detection's missed-event and false-alarm behaviour
revisit_triggers: any change to price, cancellation terms, monitoring contract or product limitations
a customer says they were never told something the packet is supposed to contain
a new device class with different limitations enters the catalogue

nodes.definition: Judge every acquisition channel by what it costs to produce a retained, well-fitting account rather than by how many sales it generated, and rebalance effort on that basis. The mix available to a local operator is narrow and each entry behaves differently: professional referral from discharge planners, home-care agencies and therapists; community education; inbound search and directory presence; word of mouth from families; and paid local advertising. Cold outbound calling to older adults is excluded outright, both because solicitation rules are an obligation class to verify currently and because it is the practice that has made this whole industry distrusted. The measurement mechanism is the operator's own: attribute every opportunity to a first source at intake, carry that attribution through to installation and then to survival past the point where the account has repaid its acquisition and equipment outlay, and divide the channel's fully-loaded cost — including the operator's own hours valued honestly — by the count of accounts that survived that far. Channels then sort themselves. The discipline is to resist judging a slow relational channel on a single quarter, and to resist keeping a fast channel that produces accounts which do not last.

included: first-source attribution carried from intake through installation to account survival
cost per retained account including the operator's own hours, as a mechanism instantiated with real spend
the exclusion of cold outbound calling to older adults and the obligation class behind it
excluded: post-installation referral generation from served families and caregivers, which belongs to the retention knowledge base
asserting any channel cost, conversion rate or industry benchmark as fact
the relationship craft of each individual channel, which is covered by the channel work units themselves

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: accumulated attribution data shows a channel's cost per retained account diverging from the assumption, or a source's volume shifts after a policy change

pros.claim: Measuring retained accounts rather than signed sales exposes the channels that generate expensive churn and flatters nothing
pros.example: discovering that opportunities from one high-volume source are disproportionately households where the wearer never assented

pros.claim: Valuing the operator's own hours honestly reveals that an apparently free relational channel is the most expensive one in the mix, or the cheapest
pros.example: costing a season of senior-centre talks at the owner's own hourly rate and comparing it against directory advertising on the same basis

cons.claim: Attribution is genuinely ambiguous when a family heard a talk, was handed a list and was then told by an aide, and forcing a single source distorts the picture
cons.example: a referral credited to the discharge list although the family only called because they recognised the name from a talk

cons.claim: Relational channels have long lags, so early measurement systematically underrates them and can kill a channel just before it works
cons.example: cutting community education after two quiet quarters, months before its accumulated familiarity would have paid

failure_modes: counting signed sales instead of surviving accounts and concluding the wrong channel is best
leaving the owner's own hours out of channel cost so relational work appears free
letting attribution lapse at intake so no channel can ever be evaluated
acceptance_tests: every opportunity carries a first-source attribution captured at intake and retained through to the survival checkpoint
each channel's cost per retained account is computed from real spend and honestly valued owner hours, with no external benchmark used
revisit_triggers: a channel's cost per retained account moves materially
a referral source's volume changes after a staffing or policy change
a new channel is trialled or an existing one is cut

nodes.definition: Hold a single blocking checkpoint between the sale and the installation schedule, so that no appointment is booked on an account that is not actually ready. The gate checks a short, non-negotiable list: the buyer triangle is mapped with a named signing party and, where authority is held by someone other than the wearer, that authority identified rather than assumed; the wearer's own assent recorded in their words with a chosen wearing style; the fit screen passed with no open disqualifying condition, including the household's connectivity situation as described; the all-in cost disclosed and the written cost page in the household's hands; the cancellation terms delivered; the packet with the limitations statement left behind; the contact and information-sharing consent captured; and the referral source recorded with its attribution. Anything missing blocks the booking rather than becoming a note for the installer to chase, because every one of these items is far more expensive to fix after equipment is in a house. The gate is also the interface to the installation and testing knowledge base: what it passes forward is a complete account file, and what that knowledge base does with it — assessment, configuration, the mandatory end-to-end signal test and training — is not this knowledge base's work.

included: the enumerated blocking checks that must all pass before an installation is scheduled
the complete account file handed to the installation and testing work
the rule that a missing item blocks booking rather than becoming an installer's task
excluded: the home assessment, device configuration, monitoring-centre integration, end-to-end signal test and wearer training, all of which belong to the device setup and testing knowledge base
installer scheduling logistics and route planning
anything that happens after the installation is complete, which belongs to the retention knowledge base

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: installations repeatedly encountering issues a gate item should have caught, or a rise in granted exceptions for urgent cases

pros.claim: One blocking checkpoint catches the whole class of problems that are cheap now and expensive once equipment is in a house
pros.example: stopping a booking because the wearer's assent was recorded second-hand from her son rather than from her

pros.claim: A complete account file lets the installation visit be about assessment and testing instead of renegotiating price and terms on the doorstep
pros.example: an installer arriving to a household that already has its cost page and cancellation terms and only needs the equipment tested and explained

cons.claim: A hard gate delays urgent discharge-window installations where the family genuinely needs the device this week
cons.example: a Friday discharge that cannot be booked because the absent daughter with signing authority has not yet been reached

cons.claim: A checklist gate can be satisfied formally without being satisfied substantively, which hides problems behind a completed form
cons.example: an assent field filled in with a phrase nobody actually heard the wearer say

failure_modes: booking on a promise that a missing item will be collected at the door
letting an urgent discharge case become a standing exception that quietly becomes the norm
handing the installation an account file with no recorded referral source, which destroys channel measurement
acceptance_tests: no installation appears on the schedule without every gate item recorded in the account file
a sampled recent account file contains the wearer's own assent wording, the delivered cost page, the cancellation terms and the source attribution
revisit_triggers: an installation encounters a problem that a gate item should have caught
an exception is granted for an urgent case
the gate list is changed or an item is added

edges.why_related: the hard stops are written against a scope that already says what this business sells and refuses
the claim classes needing substantiation follow from the equipment and service classes the charter says are carried
the fear boundary is the language-level expression of the vulnerable-consumer stops
assent can only be sought once the wearer has been identified as distinct from the payer
the payer's motives are worked only after the payer role has been assigned to a named person
the influencer corner of the triangle is what the referral landscape enumerates at market level
the boundary is set per source type, so the source inventory must exist before the boundary can be drawn
the discharge channel is one mapped source worked according to its recorded constraints
the agency alliance is one mapped source with its own permissible help form
senior centres, libraries and faith communities are mapped venues whose gatekeepers the map identifies
the all-in figure can only be assembled once every priced component of the offer exists
what happens on exit depends on whether equipment was sold, leased or loaned and whether time was prepaid
the payback mechanism depends on how and when an account is allowed to end and what is refunded
absence of assent is one of the enumerated disqualifying conditions the fit screen applies
the packet is the written residue of the disclosures the structured conversation made in order
cost per retained account is meaningless until the point at which an account has repaid its outlay is defined
the gate checks that the packet was produced and left with the household before any booking
the vulnerable-consumer stops dictate that the complete cost is stated and written before any request to decide
the stops require an exit that a grieving or confused household can actually use without argument
the alliance's reciprocity is capped at education and responsiveness because agency staff sit inside the restricted zone
nothing of value may pass to a planner, which is why the channel is worked through listings and in-services only
the talk's content and imagery are bound by the banned-pattern list, which is what keeps venues open to the operator
the moments of highest buying intent are also the moments when a frightened family is most susceptible to pressure
edges.resolution_rule: presence in a trigger window is permitted only through channels the family initiates; inside the window the fear-appeal ban tightens rather than relaxes, and no time-limited price or urgency device may be used at all

edges.why_related: the person paying wants the purchase settled today and the person wearing the device may not want it at all
edges.resolution_rule: the wearer's refusal wins: no installation is booked without the wearer's own assent, and the payer is offered a paused opportunity and a written summary rather than a workaround

edges.why_related: payback needs account longevity while easy exit deliberately makes leaving cheap and immediate
edges.resolution_rule: easy exit stands; longevity is bought instead by fit, assent and honest disclosure, and if payback still fails the answer is to change the offer structure or the acquisition cost, never to lock the customer in

edges.why_related: the discharge window rewards installing within days while the gate blocks booking until every item is complete
edges.resolution_rule: the gate holds; urgency is absorbed by working the missing items faster, and any exception requires a named approver, a written reason and a same-week completion of the missing item

edges.why_related: conceding that an alternative fits better depresses the conversion figures the channel measurement uses to judge a channel
edges.resolution_rule: channels are judged on cost per retained account rather than on conversion rate, and declines and concessions are recorded separately so an honest channel is never penalised for refusing bad-fit sales

edges.why_related: the default no-payment posture caps volume from sources that competitors are willing to pay, which makes those channels look weak on cost per account
edges.resolution_rule: the boundary is not tradeable against channel yield; a channel that can only be won by paying a clinically-adjacent source is recorded as unavailable rather than underperforming, and effort moves to permissible channels

edges.why_related: a device the wearer accepted is worn, and a worn device produces the account longevity that payback depends on
professional sources withdraw from any vendor whose clients report being frightened into buying, so language discipline determines channel durability
disclosed costs remove the invoice-surprise cancellations that otherwise inflate every channel's cost per retained account
the discharge transition is the trigger that gives this channel its unusually high intent and its unusually short response window
fit is screened before a price is quoted so that a household is never priced into an option that cannot work at their address
the alternatives, including doing nothing, are stated inside the structured conversation before any request to proceed
gate failures and post-booking surprises show which screening question was too weak and send the fit list back for revision
measured cost per retained account re-ranks the landscape and redirects relationship hours away from sources that looked promising
a payback that does not close under the current structure sends the offer back for restructuring of equipment ownership, activation or term options
both are trust-first channels where an overt pitch destroys access, and both are worked with factual material and reliability rather than with offers

conflict_axes.name: wearer_autonomy_versus_payer_urgency
conflict_axes.description: The person who pays wants the decision made now and the person who must wear the device may be reluctant, uninterested or actively opposed, and the two cannot both be satisfied on the payer's timetable.
poles: close with the paying adult child today
wait for the wearer's own assent
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the wearer holds the veto; the payer is given a written summary, a paused opportunity and an honest explanation of why an unwanted device becomes a cancelled account

conflict_axes.name: crisis_window_presence_versus_crisis_exploitation
conflict_axes.description: Buying happens inside narrow windows after falls, discharges and bereavements, which are exactly the moments when a family's judgment is most impaired and pressure is most effective.
poles: be present and available when intent is highest
refuse to trade on a family's fear
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: be findable through family-initiated and referral routes in every window, tighten the fear-appeal ban inside the window, and forbid urgency devices entirely

conflict_axes.name: disclosure_completeness_versus_conversion_speed
conflict_axes.description: Every additional disclosure — total cost, contingent charges, product limitations, honest alternatives — lengthens the conversation and loses buyers who wanted a five-minute purchase.
poles: match the speed of a call-centre competitor
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: keep the disclosure order fixed and compress its delivery instead of its content, using the one-page cost summary and the packet to carry detail the conversation cannot

conflict_axes.name: easy_exit_versus_account_payback
conflict_axes.description: The subscription only repays its equipment, installation and acquisition outlay over many months, while frictionless cancellation deliberately makes leaving cheap at any moment.
poles: protect payback with terms and commitments
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold easy exit fixed and earn longevity through fit, assent and disclosure; if payback still fails, change the offer structure or the acquisition cost rather than the exit terms

conflict_axes.name: referral_volume_versus_inducement_boundary
conflict_axes.description: The sources capable of sending the most business are the ones most tightly restricted from being paid, and competitors willing to pay will take that volume.
poles: win volume the way competitors do
hold the no-payment posture with clinically-adjacent sources
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: treat the boundary as non-tradeable, compete on responsiveness, education and reliability, and record unavailable channels as unavailable rather than as underperforming

conflict_axes.name: honest_concession_versus_channel_yield
conflict_axes.description: Conceding that a smartwatch, an unmonitored dialler or another provider fits a household better costs a sale that would otherwise have counted toward a channel's performance.
poles: concede the better fit out loud
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: measure channels on cost per retained account and log declines and concessions separately so refusing a bad-fit sale never reads as channel failure

conflict_axes.name: substantiated_caution_versus_competitive_superlative
conflict_axes.description: Sourced, condition-stated claims about battery, range, fall detection and answer performance sound weaker beside a national advertiser's flat promise of protection.
poles: state only what a named source supports
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: never match an unsupportable claim; convert the weakness into a differentiator by scheduling the verification, so what the operator promises is a measured test rather than a superlative

conflict_axes.name: relational_channel_patience_versus_cash_now
conflict_axes.description: Referral and community channels take months of unpaid relational work before producing accounts, while the business needs revenue in the current month.
poles: chase whatever produces revenue this month
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: fund a deliberate minimum of relational hours as a fixed commitment, judge those channels on a multi-quarter window, and never let a thin month convert relational effort into pressure selling

conflict_axes.name: gate_discipline_versus_discharge_window_speed
conflict_axes.description: The blocking pre-installation gate exists precisely because post-installation fixes are expensive, yet the discharge window that produces the best opportunities closes within days.
poles: book fast to catch the window
block the booking until every item is complete
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the gate and absorb urgency by working the missing items faster; permit exceptions only with a named approver, a written reason and a same-week completion

edge_cases.description: An adult child asks the operator to install the device without telling the parent, or to add location tracking the parent would not knowingly agree to
edge_cases.trigger: a payer requests covert installation or covert monitoring of a competent adult
edge_cases.mitigation: refuse outright, explain that the wearer must know and agree, offer to join a conversation with the parent present, and record a decline if the family will not proceed openly

edge_cases.description: The wearer has a diagnosis affecting memory, the payer is pressing to sign, and nobody has established who may lawfully sign
edge_cases.trigger: signing authority is unclear and capacity is in question
edge_cases.mitigation: make no capacity judgment, pause the sale, ask who holds documented authority and treat that as an obligation class to verify, and refer the family to their own adviser before proceeding

edge_cases.description: A Friday discharge is confirmed and one gate item — the absent sibling with signing authority — cannot be reached before the weekend
edge_cases.trigger: the discharge window closes before the handoff gate can be completed
edge_cases.mitigation: hold the gate, offer the family an interim option that requires no contract, and complete the booking as soon as the item clears rather than installing on a promise

edge_cases.description: The household describes no landline and unreliable mobile signal, and the family wants an installation date anyway
edge_cases.trigger: pre-sale connectivity screening indicates no viable signal path for any carried product
edge_cases.mitigation: decline to promise a date, explain that feasibility is confirmed only by an on-site assessment, offer an assessment visit with no obligation, and record the decline if nothing carried can work

edge_cases.description: A home-care aide has quoted a monthly price and promised the pendant works anywhere in the garden
edge_cases.trigger: an unpaid channel partner makes a pricing and capability claim outside their role
edge_cases.mitigation: correct the family gently with the sourced position and the real price sheet, honour nothing that was never true, and re-brief the agency on the aide boundary without blaming the individual

edge_cases.description: An agency manager proposes a fee for every signed account and treats refusal as a lack of commitment
edge_cases.trigger: a clinically-adjacent source proposes volume-contingent compensation
edge_cases.mitigation: decline in writing, explain the exposure the arrangement would create for the agency itself, offer staff education and priority scheduling instead, and record the channel as unavailable if the offer is a condition

edge_cases.description: A family asks directly whether the device will save their mother's life
edge_cases.trigger: an emotionally loaded request for a guarantee the product cannot give
edge_cases.mitigation: answer with the honest replacement wording — what happens when the button is pressed, who is called and in what order — and state plainly that no device prevents a fall or guarantees an outcome

edge_cases.description: A family compares the operator's all-in first-year figure against a national advertiser's headline monthly rate
edge_cases.trigger: an unmatched-scope price comparison during the consultation
edge_cases.mitigation: rebuild both offers on the same scope in front of the family, including equipment, activation, shipping and any term condition, and concede openly if the competitor is genuinely cheaper for their situation

edge_cases.description: The wearer dies between signing and the scheduled installation
edge_cases.trigger: a bereavement occurs before the service ever begins
edge_cases.mitigation: cancel on notification without requiring the account holder personally, refund everything taken, arrange equipment return at the operator's cost, and make no retention approach of any kind

edge_cases.description: A household clearly wants the service but the monthly cost would compete with medication or heating
edge_cases.trigger: affordability strain becomes evident during the consultation
edge_cases.mitigation: do not sell the largest package; name the lowest configuration that meets the need, point to the public ageing-services agency class for programmes that may exist, avoid any advice about their finances, and record a decline rather than creating hardship

edge_cases.description: A referral arrives carrying patient details the operator was never entitled to receive
edge_cases.trigger: a source forwards identifying information without the individual's consent
edge_cases.mitigation: do not contact the household on that basis, tell the source what may and may not be sent, delete what should not have been received, and record the incident in the channel file

edge_cases.description: A senior centre offers a speaking slot in exchange for a sponsorship payment, blurring education and paid placement
edge_cases.trigger: a venue proposes payment for access to its members
edge_cases.mitigation: treat it as advertising rather than education, verify whether the venue's own rules and the applicable inducement class permit it, and if it proceeds, disclose the paid relationship in the room and in the material

workflow.action: Write the scope and refusal charter
workflow.description: Fix what this business sells, what it refuses, and where out-of-scope questions are sent, then align every script and page to it
workflow.artifact: scope and refusal charter with named referral destinations
workflow.gate: the charter names the carried equipment and service classes, at least four out-of-scope question types with a destination each, and the decision-ownership sentence appears verbatim in the script and the website copy

workflow.action: Encode the vulnerable-consumer hard stops with their enforcement mechanisms
workflow.description: Turn each stop into a blocking step, a script line, a teach-back question or an artifact the customer keeps
workflow.artifact: hard-stop register with an enforcement mechanism per stop
workflow.gate: every stop has a named mechanism and a per-account artifact that proves it happened, and the solicitation and renewal obligation classes are flagged for current jurisdictional verification

workflow.description: For every battery, range, fall-detection and answer-performance claim, record the source document and its measurement condition, and write the downgrade wording
workflow.artifact: sourced claim sheet with conditions and downgrade wording
workflow.gate: no customer-facing figure exists without a named source and its condition, and the fall-detection wording states both missed events and false alarms

workflow.action: Write the banned-language and honest-replacement list
workflow.description: Enumerate the fear patterns that are forbidden and the exact honest sentence that replaces each one
workflow.gate: every banned pattern has a written replacement, and both appear in the training material and the community-talk outline

workflow.action: Construct the offer and its price sheet
workflow.description: Decide equipment ownership, activation, subscription, add-ons and term structure, pricing each component separately from the operator's own costs
workflow.artifact: component price sheet with ownership and term options
workflow.gate: every component and add-on carries its own charge and billing frequency, each add-on is separately declinable, and a month-to-month path is quotable without penalty language

workflow.action: Design the cancellation, refund and bereavement terms
workflow.description: Write the exit before the pitch, including who may give notice, how prepaid time is refunded and how equipment comes back
workflow.gate: the page names the notice method, proration rule, equipment-return path and any surviving charge, and the bereavement and higher-care clauses require no argument to invoke

workflow.action: Instantiate the account payback mechanism with real numbers
workflow.description: Fill the four-part mechanism from the operator's own equipment invoices, monitoring contract, processing costs and installation cost
workflow.artifact: account payback model sourced to internal documents
workflow.gate: every term traces to a named internal document and the payback duration is derived rather than assumed, with no external benchmark used

workflow.action: Map the referral landscape and fix the inducement boundary
workflow.description: Inventory local sources with their constraints and needs, then decide in writing what may be given in return, verified with counsel
workflow.artifact: referral landscape register with a written reciprocity policy
workflow.gate: each source carries its constraint note, permissible help form, stated need and named contact, and the reciprocity policy records that current jurisdictional rules were verified before any arrangement

workflow.action: Open the professional channels on their own terms
workflow.description: Deliver factual capability sheets and staff in-services to discharge units and home-care agencies, and commit only to responsiveness the business can actually staff
workflow.artifact: channel opening pack: capability sheet, in-service outline, agency briefing
workflow.gate: materials contain only sourced claims and no superlatives, the aide and planner boundaries are written and acknowledged, and no patient information is received without the individual's consent

workflow.action: Map the buyer triangle and obtain wearer assent per opportunity
workflow.description: Name the wearer, payer, influencer and signing authority, then speak with the wearer directly and record their own words about wanting the device
workflow.artifact: opportunity record with roles, concerns, veto status and assent wording
workflow.gate: the wearer has been spoken with or a documented reason exists, the assent wording is in the wearer's own words, and the referral source is recorded at intake

workflow.action: Run the disclosure-first consultation with the fit screen
workflow.description: Follow the fixed order: identify, define, listen, screen fit, state limits, give the all-in cost and exit terms, state alternatives, then ask
workflow.artifact: consultation record plus the written summary left with the household
workflow.gate: cost and cancellation terms were disclosed before any request to proceed, no disqualifying condition is open, and the household holds a written summary whether or not they bought

workflow.action: Leave the packet and pass the handoff gate
workflow.description: Assemble the customer packet, capture consents, and check every blocking item before the installation is scheduled
workflow.artifact: complete account file plus the customer packet left in the home
workflow.gate: no installation is scheduled unless roles, assent wording, fit clearance, cost page, cancellation terms, limitations statement, contact consent and source attribution are all recorded

priority_rationale: The frame work units come first because the scope charter, the vulnerable-consumer hard stops, the substantiation rule and the fear-appeal boundary govern every sentence and every channel that follows, and rewriting them later means recalling material already in the market; the buyer-triangle units come next because who wears, who pays, who influences and who may sign determines the shape of every conversation and every referral relationship; channel building follows the triangle and is itself gated by the inducement boundary, which must be settled before any healthcare-adjacent source is approached; offer design, disclosure, exit terms and the payback mechanism form the commercial layer that the consultation then delivers in a fixed disclosure-first order; and the packet, the handoff gate and channel economics come last because they compose everything above into an account file that installation can act on and into a measurement that tells the operator which channels are actually worth the hours.

dominance_rules.rule: The vulnerable-consumer hard stops dominate every revenue consideration
dominance_rules.rationale: the buying population cannot absorb a bad outcome and a single pressured sale discredits the business with the professionals it depends on
dominance_rules.trigger: a stop would block a sale the business needs
dominance_rules.action: block the sale, record the reason, and treat the shortfall as a channel problem rather than as a reason to relax the stop

dominance_rules.rationale: a device the wearer never accepted becomes an unworn pendant, a cancellation and a family that feels sold to
dominance_rules.trigger: the payer wants to proceed and the wearer has not agreed in their own words
dominance_rules.action: pause the opportunity, leave a written summary, and book nothing until the wearer assents

dominance_rules.rationale: an unsupported reliability claim is discovered exactly when it matters most, and it takes the referral source down with it
dominance_rules.trigger: a competitor's superlative creates pressure to match it
dominance_rules.action: state only what a named source supports, and offer the scheduled installation test as the verification instead

dominance_rules.rule: The referral-inducement boundary dominates channel volume
dominance_rules.rationale: an improper arrangement exposes the referrer as well as the operator and is not curable after the fact
dominance_rules.trigger: a source proposes or expects payment, gifts or a revenue split
dominance_rules.action: decline, offer education and responsiveness instead, and record the channel as unavailable rather than negotiating the boundary

dominance_rules.rule: Full cost disclosure dominates conversion optimisation
dominance_rules.rationale: invoice surprise is the mechanism by which this industry loses trust, and it is entirely preventable at the point of sale
dominance_rules.trigger: quoting only a monthly figure would improve the chance of a yes
dominance_rules.action: give the all-in first-year figure and the ongoing monthly figure in writing before any request to decide

dominance_rules.rule: The decline list dominates a short month
dominance_rules.rationale: sales made against the disqualifying conditions become refunds, complaints and lost referral sources within months
dominance_rules.trigger: an opportunity meets a disqualifying condition while revenue is behind
dominance_rules.action: decline with the scripted wording, offer the named alternative, and write the decline record

dominance_rules.rule: The scope charter dominates the urge to be helpful
dominance_rules.rationale: a clinical, capacity, legal or benefit-eligibility answer given by a salesperson is both unqualified and commercially conflicted
dominance_rules.trigger: a family asks a medical, capacity, legal, tax or coverage-eligibility question
dominance_rules.action: use the refusal sentence, name the neutral destination, and return to what the equipment and service actually do

dominance_rules.rationale: longevity bought with lock-in is the practice this business exists to be an alternative to, and referrers judge cancellations closely
dominance_rules.trigger: payback pressure creates an argument for terms, penalties or notice periods that make leaving harder
dominance_rules.action: hold the exit terms and change the offer structure or the acquisition cost instead

dominance_rules.rule: The handoff gate dominates schedule pressure
dominance_rules.rationale: every gate item is far cheaper to complete before equipment is in a house than after
dominance_rules.trigger: an urgent discharge or a family's travel date argues for booking with an item outstanding
dominance_rules.action: hold the booking; permit an exception only with a named approver, a written reason and a same-week completion of the missing item

dominance_rules.rule: Recorded consent dominates every information flow to referrers and family
dominance_rules.rationale: the household's information belongs to the household, and channel goodwill is never a reason to share it
dominance_rules.trigger: a referring professional or a family member asks what happened with an account or a lead
dominance_rules.action: share only what the recorded consent permits, and say plainly that consent is the reason for the limit

anti_rework_rules.rule: Write the scope charter and the banned-language list before any marketing copy, script or talk outline is drafted
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a website, script and community talk that must all be rewritten once the boundaries are finally articulated, after the wrong promises are already in the market

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix the referral-inducement boundary before approaching any healthcare-adjacent source
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an arrangement that must be unwound after it exists, damaging both the source's standing and the relationship it was meant to build

anti_rework_rules.rule: Map the buyer triangle and obtain wearer assent before quoting a price
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a full pricing and configuration conversation with a payer for a device the wearer will refuse, and the cancellation that follows if it is installed anyway

anti_rework_rules.rule: Screen connectivity and fit before promising any installation date
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an installation visit that fails its own signal test and a household that must be unwound after equipment has been carried into their home

anti_rework_rules.rule: Design the cancellation terms before designing the pitch
anti_rework_rules.prevents: selling on promises the exit terms then contradict, and rewriting the offer after the first family tries to leave

anti_rework_rules.rule: Instantiate the payback mechanism from real invoices before setting price or committing channel spend
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a price and an acquisition budget that cannot repay equipment and installation cost, discovered only after a book of accounts exists at that price

anti_rework_rules.rule: Substantiate every reliability claim before it enters a capability sheet, a talk or a script
anti_rework_rules.prevents: recalling material from hospital units and senior centres and correcting families who were told something the operator cannot support

anti_rework_rules.rule: Capture first-source attribution at intake rather than at close
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a pipeline that cannot be evaluated by channel, forcing months of guesswork about where retained accounts actually came from

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record contact and information-sharing consent at the sale, before any referrer or family member is told anything
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reconstructing permissions after the fact, and the trust damage of having told a professional something the household never authorised

iteration_protocol.trigger: a customer or family member reports feeling pressured, frightened or rushed into buying
iteration_protocol.action: audit recent consultations against the fixed disclosure order and the banned-pattern list, retrain, and tighten whichever stop was skipped

iteration_protocol.trigger: a billing dispute or early cancellation cites a charge the customer says was never disclosed
iteration_protocol.action: trace the charge to the price sheet and the packet, repair the disclosure page, and re-issue the corrected packet to affected households

iteration_protocol.trigger: an installation fails its end-to-end signal test on an account that passed the pre-sale screen
iteration_protocol.action: add or sharpen the screening question that would have caught it and re-check open opportunities against the revised screen

iteration_protocol.trigger: a referral source proposes payment, a gift or a revenue split
iteration_protocol.action: decline in writing, re-verify the current rules for that source type with counsel, and update the reciprocity policy and the channel record

iteration_protocol.trigger: early cancellations cluster in a way that traces back to how accounts were sold
iteration_protocol.action: re-examine assent quality and configuration fit for the affected cohort, recompute payback with the observed longevity, and correct the sales practice that produced them

iteration_protocol.trigger: the wholesale monitoring rate, equipment cost or payment-processing cost changes
iteration_protocol.action: recompute the payback mechanism and restructure the offer if payback no longer closes, without touching the exit terms

iteration_protocol.trigger: a named referral contact leaves, or a source organisation changes its vendor or transition policy
iteration_protocol.action: refresh the landscape entry, re-establish the relationship with the successor, and re-check whether the channel's constraints have changed

iteration_protocol.trigger: a competitor changes its offering, or a consumer device becomes a realistic substitute
iteration_protocol.action: re-source the comparison material, refresh the concession cases, and retire any claim that can no longer be supported

iteration_protocol.trigger: a handoff-gate exception is granted for an urgent case
iteration_protocol.action: record the approver and reason, confirm the missing item completed within the week, and review whether repeated exceptions mean the gate or the process needs changing
